paragraphs.text:
Without a sound, Sylvia goes down under the freezing energy 
of the creature’s ray. You and Norman reach the cover of the 
trees and head for a clump where the canopy is thickest.

Once the flyer seems to be gone, you creep back to the wood’s 
edge. The bodies of Sylvia and Bernard have vanished.

To explore the valley with Norman, go to 213. To leave it, go 
to 361.
